title: Red Hat Security Advisory: mysql:8.4 security update
description: A security update for the mysql:8.4 module in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 addresses a denial of service vulnerability in the rapidjson library used by MySQL. The issue involves an out-of-bounds read in the regex parser component of rapidjson (CVE-2026-116620). This vulnerability could allow an attacker to cause a denial of service condition. Red Hat has released an update to fix this issue.
